svg.title: Full Ran tensor reconstruction and derived spectral paths
svg.desc: The full operator self-duality kernel, reconstruction from all Ran parameters, the entire compact-DG coend representing spectral tensor isomorphisms, and the negative-degree diagonal coordinate and degree-two paths in the projective-line torus example. General diagonal pushforward and localization remain unproved.
svg.text: Recovering tensor coefficients and their derived paths
Complex projective curve; all full operator parameters and coherent finite-set maps.
1. Actual full operator self-duality — SDG.1–SDG.3
ev(Q,N) = p_*(Q ⊗! N), coev(C) = Δ_*ω_X
p₁,* (Δ_*ω_X ⊗! p₂!M) ≃ M, for every full unbounded M.
Replacing ω_X by k_X gives M[−2], not the identity (Solution 3.BI).
The two actual kernel triangles give Dmod(X) ≃ Dmod(X)∨.
2. Full Ran tensor reconstruction — SDG.4–SDG.10
Fun⊗,L(R,A) ≃ Fun⊗,L(C,A ⊗ Dmod(X))
E_F(V) represents N ↦ F(ins_id(V ⊗ N)) on the entire parameter category.
Coefficient fold + parameter diagonal recover E_F(V ⊗ W) ≃ E_F(V) ⊗! E_F(W).
Empty labels recover E_F(1) = 1_A ⊠ ω_X; full bars retain every higher map.
A here is a presentable symmetric monoidal category, not only an ordinary ring.
3. Actual pair algebra and all spectral paths — SDG.11–SDG.16
D_z,w = ∫_(T∈R^c) F_z(T)∨ ⊗ᴸ_A F_w(T)
Map_CAlg_A(D_z,w,B) ≃ Isom⊗(E_wB,E_zB) = Path_Z(B)(w_B,z_B)
The dual first factor is the target: the tensor isomorphism goes from w_B to z_B.
D_z,w ⊗ᴸ_A B ≃ D_zB,wB; no flatness is assumed.
The coend uses the entire compact DG category and all its enriched bar relations.
4. Derived projective-line torus fibre — SDG.20–SDG.27; Solution 3.BK
X = P¹, Ĝ = G_m, z trivial: D_z,z = C[u,u⁻¹] ⊗ Sym(C[2])
The extra free coordinate has cochain degree −2; ordinary points cannot see it.
B = C[δ]/(δ²), |δ| = −2: units are u + q δη, |η| = 2, η² = 0.
π₀ Path_Z(B)(z_B,z_B) = C× × C; π₂ = C; all other π_i (i>0) vanish.
For B = C only C× remains, with no positive homotopy groups.
Full Čech–Spencer composition proves the square-zero endomorphism model.
5. The point-pair path theorem and the remaining geometric step
General G: all derived affine-point path spaces are identified, with higher maps.
Still required: general connectivity/affinity and the diagonal unit pushforward.
Also required: global quasicoherent tensor comparison and actual localization.
Global projected generation, the ordinary projector and its nilpotent image remain.
Nilpotent regularity, derived tempered Satake and other geometric fields remain.
